svg.text: Region ap-south-1 (Mumbai) · CI/CD with GitHub Actions
integrated in code · model access quota pending
Provider interface: swap Bedrock in once quota is granted
• CI gates both deploys: they run only if pytest passes on that commit, and run in parallel.
• The app reaches DynamoDB and Secrets Manager through an IAM instance role; no credentials in source code.
• Elastic Beanstalk environment: load balancer, health checks and environment parameters are configured.
